canon_ref.note: The day after the skeleton. Erin wakes at [Innkeeper] Level 12. She pays with meals for the four days left in the week. Delta is a design value.

b1.pawn_builds_an_outhouse.summary: The skeleton fetches water and fruit and startles Erin all morning. Pawn and two Workers come to play chess; he says the Queen is busy with something below and a new Prognugator walks above. For a week of meals they spend the day building Erin a sturdy outhouse.

b1.adventurers_attack_goblins_at_inn.news: Three Human adventurers wrecked the inn on the hill trying to kill the Goblins eating there. Gazi of Reim sent them running.

stage.line: Three armed Human adventurers come in looking for rooms. One sees the Goblins and draws his sword: 'Goblins!'

waves.line: Rags and her Goblins jump up from their table with knives out.

stage.note: Design: 3 foes (canon). Rags and two of her band join at once (they ate inside); Pawn and the skeleton fight if they are in the inn. Gazi comes after the fight, not on the map. The foes run early (flee_below): in canon they run, not die. Hours are a guess.

hooks.news: Three Human adventurers attacked the Goblins at the inn on the hill. A Human guest there fought on the Goblins' side, and Gazi of Reim sent the three running.

canon_ref.note: That evening, as the sun meets the mountains; Gazi leaves ten minutes before. The Goblins cut the men's potion bags while they are down. Deltas are design values.

b1.adventurers_attack_goblins_at_inn.summary: Three Human adventurers see Rags's Goblins and go for them. The skeleton, the Goblins, Pawn's Workers and Erin fight back; Erin fells the last with a thrown frying pan. They threaten to bring a mob, until Gazi returns and scares them off in the name of Reim. Half the furniture is kindling.

canon_ref.note: Walking back to Liscor that night. She sees Erin's [Immortal Moment] and that the market thief is a [Princess]. A cold front will freeze the land for at least a week.

b1.gazi_marks_erin_and_pisces.summary: Gazi judges both worthy of waking her sleeping King: Erin, who defends Goblins against her own kind and has a Skill Gazi has never seen, and Pisces, who made an undead that levels. She will wait and watch. Krshia's Gnolls tail her. She sees the market thief is a mere [Princess].

system.name: [Innkeeper]
system.note: In her sleep after the skeleton came (night 27, guess).

system.name: [Innkeeper]
system.note: The night of the fight, while she thinks of names for the skeleton.
